snippet.title: 75 Demons 👺 - Trailer
snippet.description:
A roguelike demonic combat game with deck-building where you must predict your enemy's moves to land your blows. Fast-paced combat, numerous items and weapons to unleash powerful attacks, and unique effects that will turn the battle in your favor. Unfold your strategy in the demonic arena with a huge variety of attacks that will change your game depending on which ones you choose. Set in a Japanese x Christian mythology, 75 Demons proposes a game where your concentration and intuition will be key to winning.

Coming Soon on Steam and Itch.io
